name: Advanced Tactical Academy: Fire Over the Ridge

lessons.title: Fire Over the Ridge
lessons.text: Bring the Archer's LRMs to bear with a mobile spotter.

lessons.title: Movement plan
lessons.text: Keep the Archer behind the ridge where possible; send the Wolverine to a position that sees the target.

lessons.title: Fire plan
lessons.text: Choose indirect fire when direct line of sight is blocked. Check spotter movement and whether the spotter fires too.

lessons.title: Review the tradeoffs
lessons.text: Watch ammunition and heat; indirect attacks are not automatically better than direct attacks.

lessons.title: Review
lessons.text: Review the battle record and retry to improve your practice.
